mapper.select: SELECT i.price_item_id AS priceItemId, s.sku_id AS skuId, s.sku_code AS skuCode, s.sku_name AS productName, u.unit_id AS unitId, u.unit_name AS unitName, (SELECT bc.barcode_value FROM cat_sku_unit su2 JOIN cat_barcode bc ON bc.tenant_id = su2.tenant_id AND bc.sku_unit_id = su2.sku_unit_id WHERE su2.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND su2.sku_id = i.sku_id AND su2.unit_id = i.unit_id AND bc.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY bc.barcode_id LIMIT 1) AS barcode, i.amount_minor AS amountMinor, i.currency, i.effective_from AS effectiveFrom, i.effective_to AS effectiveTo FROM prc_price_item i JOIN prc_price_book b ON b.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND b.price_book_id = i.price_book_id JOIN cat_sku s ON s.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND s.sku_id = i.sku_id JOIN cat_unit u ON u.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND u.unit_id = i.unit_id WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.price_book_id = #{priceBookId} AND b.state IN ('PUBLISHED', 'RETIRED') ORDER BY i.effective_from, i.sku_id, i.unit_id, i.price_item_id
